svg.text: Positions 1–8 (defined) and 9–16 (reserved) are hashed identically — both are always present.
Positions 1–8 — always real content, or hash(0x00) if this block has none
Positions 9–16 — always hash(0x00) until a future spec version assigns them
prefix byte for leaf nodes (no children)
prefix byte for internal nodes with two
children — used at every level of this tree,
including where a half is entirely
Positions 9–16 use E for every leaf until a
future spec version assigns them a real
sub-tree — this half is never omitted, and its
parent is never a single-child (0x01) node.
Activating a reserved position later only
changes that position's own value from E to a
real root hash — no node is ever added or removed.
